Imagery shows gravel pull-offs between the shore road and the lake (a travel trailer parked at ~37.6918,-88.3856, ~25 m from the shore over mown grass), and a wooded road with clearings 200-300 m north of the lake. Camper reviews (aggregators) single out site 22 for lake views. No site numbers can be placed, so no lakefront; if the reviewer reads the evidence as too thin, the fallback is not waterfront.
PHONE: none -> 618-276-4405 (DNR park page 'Park Phone'; Google Maps the same).
FEES NOTE: the stored '$10 reservation processing fee from 2027' is wrong here (no reservations; permit from staff on arrival) - removed.
HORSES: passes on the page's wording ('An equestrian campground also exists' - a separate campground); its location was not confirmed on imagery.
